newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion down near close on poor buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion down near close on poor buying.

text.p: Gold and silver prices opened lower on the back of overnight losses in the world market and receded further towards the close amid sluggish physical buying, dealers said on Wednesday.
On Tuesday gold was up by 20 rupees per 10 grammes while silver was up by 115 rupees per kg.
"Fresh arrivals of the imported metals remained low today but sluggish buying enquiries and falling global prices kept stockists active sellers throughout the day," one trader said.
Meanwhile prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 300 rupees lower at 57,300 rupees per piece.
